title: Industrial Disputes Act, 1947 — Section 25N (Conditions precedent to retrenchment)

content.overview: Section 25N requires three months' notice or wages in lieu, and prior permission, before retrenchment in an establishment covered by Chapter VB.
content.glance: Section 25N requires three months' notice or wages in lieu, and prior permission, before retrenchment in an establishment covered by Chapter VB.
content.study: No workman employed in an industrial establishment to which Chapter VB applies, who has been in continuous service for not less than one year, shall be retrenched until three months' notice or wages in lieu are given and prior permission of the appropriate Government or specified authority is obtained.
